cd /workspace && python3 - << 'EOF'
import json, subprocess, sys, time, random
sys.path.insert(0, 'tmp'); sys.path.insert(0, 'submission')
import ref, main as M
N = 64
cyc = [1000 + 11*i for i in range(N)]
rnd = random.Random(2)
rib = []
for L in range(3, 21):
    for s in range(N):
        if len(rib) >= 998: break
        p = [cyc[(s+j) % N] for j in range(L)]
        rib.append({'path': p, 'count': rnd.randint(1, 1000)})
        rib.append({'path': p[::-1], 'count': rnd.randint(1, 1000)})
rib = rib[:998]
agg = {}
for r in rib:
    t = tuple(r['path']); agg[t] = agg.get(t,0)+r['count']
final, rounds = M.peel(list(agg.items()))
core=set()
for p in final:
    for i in range(len(p)-1): core.add(M._canon(p[i],p[i+1]))
order = ref.find_order(ref.scope_graph(ref.ref_occurrences(final), core))
doc = {'version':1,'ixps':[],'rib':rib,'priors':[],'declared':[],
       'order':[[u,v] for u,v in order],
       'queries':[{'id':'q%d'%i,'path':[cyc[(i+j)%N] for j in range(64)],'threshold':[1,2]} for i in range(512)]}
data = json.dumps(doc).encode()
t0=time.time()
p = subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','/workspace/submission/main.py'],input=data,capture_output=True,cwd='/workspace')
t1=time.time()
out = json.loads(p.stdout.decode())
print("counts~1000: elapsed %.2fs rc %d links %d queries %d" % (t1-t0, p.returncode, len(out.get('links',[])), len(out.get('queries',[]))))
print("sample:", {k: out['queries'][0][k] for k in ('status','score','full','witness','leaked')})
# same with max counts
rib2 = [dict(r, count=1000000) for r in rib]
doc2 = dict(doc, rib=rib2)
data2 = json.dumps(doc2).encode()
t0=time.time()
p2 = subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','/workspace/submission/main.py'],input=data2,capture_output=True,cwd='/workspace')
t1=time.time()
out2 = json.loads(p2.stdout.decode())
print("counts=1e6:  elapsed %.2fs rc %d links %d queries %d" % (t1-t0, p2.returncode, len(out2.get('links',[])), len(out2.get('queries',[]))))
print("sample:", {k: out2['queries'][0][k] for k in ('status','score','full','witness','leaked')})
EOF
